12902-a-textbook-of-theosophy.title: A Textbook Of Theosophy
12902-a-textbook-of-theosophy.creator: Unknown
12902-a-textbook-of-theosophy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It deals with the present by describing what man really is, as seen by means of developed faculties. It is customary to speak of man as having a soul. Theosophy, as the result of direct investigation, reverses that dictum, and states that man _is_ a soul, and _has_ a body--in fact several bodies, which are his vehicles and instruments in various worlds.

arxiv-2201-02196.title: Unexciting classical backgrounds
arxiv-2201-02196.creator: Tanmay Vachaspati
arxiv-2201-02196.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tanmay Vachaspati. Quantum fields in time-dependent backgrounds generally lead to particle production. Here we consider “unexciting” backgrounds for which the net particle production vanishes. We start by considering the simple harmonic oscillator and explicitly construct all unexciting time-dependent frequencies. This allows us to construct homogeneous backgrounds in field theory for which there is no particle production in any given mode, though we are able to show that there are no homogeneous backgrounds for which the particle production vanishes in every mode.

arxiv-2201-03124.title: Minimum quantum degrees with Maya diagrams
arxiv-2201-03124.creator: Ryan M. Shifler
arxiv-2201-03124.description: Abstract . We use Maya diagrams to refine the criterion by Fulton and Woodward for the smallest powers of the quantum parameter q q that occur in a product of Schubert classes in the (small) quantum cohomology of partial flags. Our approach using Maya diagrams yields a combinatorial proof that the minimal quantum degrees are unique for partial flags.

arxiv-2212-11884.title: The central limit theorem via doubling of variables
arxiv-2212-11884.creator: Louigi Addario-Berry, Gavin Barill, Erin Beckman, Jessica Lin
arxiv-2212-11884.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Louigi Addario-Berry, Gavin Barill, Erin Beckman, Jessica Lin. We give a new, self-contained proof of the multidimensional central limit theorem using the technique of “doubling variables,” which is traditionally used to prove uniqueness of solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs).

arxiv-2306-12199.title: Stability of ı \imath canonical bases of locally finite type
arxiv-2306-12199.creator: Hideya Watanabe
arxiv-2306-12199.description: Abstract . We prove the stability conjecture of ı \imath canonical bases, which was raised by Huanchen Bao and Weiqiang Wang in 2016, for all locally finite types. To this end, we characterize the trivial module over the ı \imath quantum groups of such type at q = ∞ q=\infty .

arxiv-2401-12353.title: A model comparison of 2D Cartesian and 2D axisymmetric models for positive streamer discharges in air
arxiv-2401-12353.creator: Zhen Wang, Anbang Sun, Jannis Teunissen
arxiv-2401-12353.description: Abstract Simulating streamer discharges in 3D can computationally be very expensive, which is why 2D Cartesian simulations are sometimes used instead, especially when dealing with complex geometries. Although 2D Cartesian simulations can only be used to obtain qualitative results, it is nevertheless interesting to understand how they differ from their 3D or axisymmetric counterparts.

pmc-11429669.title: Androgen Deprivation Benefits in Low-Dose-Rate Brachytherapy With Hydrogel Spacer
pmc-11429669.creator: Koyo Kikuchi, Shuhei Ishii, Yoshiro Ieko, Takafumi Segawa, Ryuji Nakamura, Hisanori Ariga
pmc-11429669.description: Introduction: We aim to investigate the impact of rectal dose reduction of both androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) and concurrent hydrogel spacer placement (HSP) in patients treated with low-dose-rate (LDR) brachytherapy for prostate cancer and to determine whether there are variations in the degree of efficacy of dose reduction across different segments of the rectum.

pmc-12383766.title: Chlamydia trachomatis-Specific Antibodies and In Vitro Fertilization Outcome
pmc-12383766.creator: Natasa Djordjevic, Ana Todorovic, Predrag Sazdanovic, Maja Sazdanovic, Marija Sorak, Aleksandra Gavrilovic, Aida Parandilovic, Eliana Garalejic, Marija Vujovic, Sanja Matic, Suzana Popovic, Dejan Baskic, Dimitrios Papageorgiou
pmc-12383766.description: Objectives: Chlamydia trachomatis (CT) infection affects female fertility. The purpose of our study was to assess the association between serological and follicular fluid markers of CT infection and in vitro fertilization (IVF) success. Methods: This prospective multicenter cohort study included female patients undergoing an IVF procedure in Serbia. The IVF procedure was performed according to the standard protocol.

pmc-12626980.title: Trends in cannabis use disorder and treatment by race and ethnicity, 2002–2019
pmc-12626980.creator: Mireia Triguero Roura, Aabha Vora, Evan L. Eschliman, Pia M. Mauro
pmc-12626980.description: Aims/backgroundAs cannabis use continues to increase in the United States, racialized stereotypes and structural barriers to care might lead to inequitable treatment uptake across racialized groups. A greater understanding of racial disparities in cannabis treatment uptake and perceived treatment need among people with cannabis use disorder (CUD) in community-based samples is needed.

pmc-12750850.title: Effect of hyaluronic acid on the prevention of medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw in a bisphosphonate-treated rat model
pmc-12750850.creator: Khalid Gachayev, Göksel Şimşek Kaya, Mahir Kaya, Öznur Özalp, Büşra Altunay, Havva Serap Toru
pmc-12750850.description: BackgroundMedication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ) remains a major clinical concern due to its complex pathogenesis and low treatment success rates. Hyaluronic acid (HA), a widely used biomaterial, has demonstrated regenerative and angiogenic potential.AimThis study investigated the effects of HA on the onset of MRONJ following tooth extraction in bisphosphonate (BP)-treated rats.

pmc-12997299.title: Public Oral Healthcare Utilisation and Its Associated Factors in Malaysian Adults: A Time-Series Analysis (1992-2019)
pmc-12997299.creator: Yeung R’ong Tan, Lokman Najihah, Jamaludin Marhazlinda
pmc-12997299.description: Introduction and aimsUnderstanding the trend and associated factors are essential for enhancing equitable access to care, particularly given persistent disparities in healthcare utilisation across different population groups. This study examined the trend and factors associated with public oral healthcare services utilisation among adults in Malaysia over a 28-year period.

pmc-13273709.title: Emergency renal autotransplantation for kidney salvage following iatrogenic renal artery occlusion after aortic stent deployment: A case report
pmc-13273709.creator: Hung Ngoc Pham, Anh Van Quoc Nguyen, Can Van Truong, Tuan Kim Nguyen, Viet Huu Quoc Phan, Tuan Minh Truong, Phuc Dai Hong Vo, Hieu Van Le, Xuan Thi My Hoang, Dung Duc Nguyen, Kha Cong Le Bui
pmc-13273709.description: Renal autotransplantation (RAT) is an established reconstructive technique but is rarely used as an emergency salvage procedure. We report a 20-year-old male with Takayasu arteritis who developed acute left renal artery occlusion following endovascular stenting of infrarenal aortic stenosis. Imaging confirmed complete occlusion of the renal artery ostium due to stent coverage, precluding endovascular revascularization.

pmc-13360579.title: On the Ability of Bismuth to Couple Weakly Coordinating Anions
pmc-13360579.creator: Lucas Mele, Reena Balhara, Dimitrios A. Pantazis, Josep Cornella
pmc-13360579.description: Similar to aryldiazonium salts, hypervalent bismuth species have been shown to promote coupling of weakly coordinating anions (WCAs) such as triflate and tetrafluoroborate. In this study, we identify the origin of the driving force for these transformations by quantifying scalar relativistic effects in high‑valent bismuth chemistry.

pmc-13374291.title: Internet gaming disorder and verbal communication skills: the predictive role of listening and speaking skills in internet gaming disorder
pmc-13374291.creator: Uğur Tekeoğlu, Bekir Gökçe
pmc-13374291.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study is to examine the impact of verbal communication skills, including speaking self-efficacy and different listening styles, on Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD). In this context, it is considered that weak communication skills may increase the tendency towards digital games. Accordingly, the study investigates the predictive role of middle school students’ verbal communication skills on IGD.

uslaw-usc-t18-s3.title: 18 U.S.C. § 3 — Accessory after the fact
uslaw-usc-t18-s3.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s3.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 1 (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, knowing that an offense against the United States has been committed, receives, relieves, comforts or assists the offender in order to hinder or prevent his apprehension, trial or punishment, is an accessory after the fact. Except as otherwise expressly provided.
